description: GmailDraftCreateComponent — create a Gmail DRAFT (never sends) templated from an upstream asset's row.

access_token.label: Access Token
access_token.description: Google OAuth2 access token scoped for gmail.compose (or gmail.modify). Use ${GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN} for env vars.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset whose materialized value supplies the template fields -- a dict-shaped record, or a pandas DataFrame (one row is selected via row_index).

row_index.label: Row Index
row_index.description: When the upstream value is a DataFrame, the 0-based row position to draft from. Ignored for a dict-shaped upstream value.

to_email.label: To Email
to_email.description: Address the draft is addressed to. This is almost always the pipeline-running user's own address (a reviewable draft lands in their own mailbox), not a third party -- the Gmail API can only draft/send as the authenticated account. Supports `{field}` placeholders.

subject_template.label: Subject Template
subject_template.description: Draft subject line, with `{column}` placeholders templated against the upstream row/record.

body_template.label: Body Template
body_template.description: Draft body (plain text), with `{column}` placeholders templated against the upstream row/record.

cc_emails.label: Cc Emails
cc_emails.description: Optional list of Cc recipient addresses.

bcc_emails.label: Bcc Emails
bcc_emails.description: Optional list of Bcc recipient addresses.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If True, render and log the MIME message but don't call the Gmail API or create a draft. Use for staging/testing templates.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Useful for transient errors like network glitches or Gmail API rate limits.

name: Gmail Draft Create
